closure_detail.C-007: Independently re-verified GREEN, maximally skeptical. Read resources/js/components/DefaultComponent.vue directly (current HEAD 0680c45c4, 2026-08-16 11:15:43+02:00): data() default theme is 'frontend' (never 'backend'); created() is now empty (comment-only, no synchronous applyThemeFromRoute call); beforeMount() wraps BOTH this.applyThemeFromRoute(this.$route) AND the authcheck dispatch inside the SAME this.$router.isReady().then(() => {...}) callback (lines 172-185) -- confirms the exact fix the task asked to verify. Confirmed public/js/app.js was rebuilt at 10:54 (after the source change) and the fresh capture set (mtimes 16:41-16:42) postdates that rebuild -- not stale evidence. Grepped all 6 *-admin-cookie.console.json for 'default-access', 'setting/branch', 'authcheck': zero matches in all 6. Confirmed these are NOT empty/broken captures: each file has 6-7 real JSON entries, all CSP connect-src info-level reports for legitimate frontend/tracking bootstrap calls (setting, order/track, language, item-category) -- the identical entry pattern (same URLs, same count class) appears in the paired *-anon.console.json files, proving the capture pipeline is actively logging and the admin-cookie context differs from anon ONLY in the absence of the 3 previously-leaked admin URLs, not in total silence. Also confirmed via tests/e2e/test-e2e-goal-4chantiers-wave-C.spec.js:349 that loginAsAdmin(page) establishes a genuine authenticated staff session before capture -- the admin-cookie fixture is real, not a vacuous empty-cookie context.
closure_detail.third_leak_path_check: Investigated whether any OTHER component mounted under the same theme==='backend' v-if branch could fire an unwanted bootstrap call during a transient theme state. Checked all files in resources/js/components/layouts/backend/: BackendMenuComponent.vue mounted() (line 311) calls only this.defaultSidebarActive(), a local/synchronous method with no $store.dispatch and no axios call -- confirmed SAFE, no leak vector. Then checked the two other components mounted in the SAME v-if="theme === 'backend' && !isKioskRoute" > v-if="logged" branch (DefaultComponent.vue:29,35) that are outside layouts/backend/: PromoFlyerPrintListener.vue and KitchenTicketPrintListener.vue both have mounted() hooks, but both defer their first real network call via `window.setTimeout(() => this._start(), START_DELAY_MS)` with START_DELAY_MS=4000 (4 full seconds, grep-confirmed in both files), and both correctly clear that timer in beforeUnmount(). A theme flash-mount/unmount cycle driven by router.isReady() resolution happens on a microtask/promise-tick timescale, many orders of magnitude faster than 4000ms, so even under the OLD (round-1/round-2) bug these two listeners never had time to fire their first axios.post before unmounting -- consistent with them never appearing among the leaked URLs in any of the 3 rounds' console.json evidence. CONCLUSION: no third leak path found. BackendNavbarComponent was the only component in this branch with a SYNCHRONOUS unconditional dispatch in mounted(), and the round-3 fix closes the leak at the correct level (theme computation itself), not by patching that one component -- so this class of bug cannot resurface via a sibling component unless a future addition to this v-if branch reintroduces a synchronous unconditional dispatch.
